answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to post a stake that is locked for a long horizon before it may vote or earn. A newcomer pays real copper on-chain, and each additional fake account must match that same deposit with fresh funds, so thousands of sockpuppets become thousands of locked positions. Because rewards vest only at the final vertex of the vesting curve, a farm that splits early forfeits most of its value and pays more than it collects.
